questions.stem: What is shadow banking entity?

options.a: A licensed subsidiary of the traditional banking system to cater to the needs of the unbanked
options.b: Non-banking financial institutions that aren’t supervised under regular banking regulations
options.c: The financial organizations that work beyond the ambit of the Indian judicial system
options.d: The financial companies backed by commercial banks to provide banking services

questions.stem: What is the significance of NBFC?

options.a: It works parallel to regulated banks and makes diverse banking services convenient for people
options.b: It regularizes scheduled commercial banks for better outreach of financial facilities
options.c: It aids commercial banks and state governments in case of financial crisis
options.d: As NBFCs are debt recovery tribunals, they recover bad debts of commercial banks

questions.stem: Why do NBFCs not subject to the banking regulation?

options.a: Because NBFCs are constituted by foreign authorities to provide banking services
options.b: They execute discretion as per the requirements of the customer, thus brings greater risk
options.c: They only provide facilities provisioned under agreement with nonbank financial institutions
options.d: They are imposter organisations that lure customers by claiming returns beyond any market value

questions.stem: Which of the following options is false with respect to the information given in the passage?

options.a: NBFCs came under the purview of RBI in the year 1965
options.b: NBFCs contribute greatly to the Indian economy by adding almost 13% of the GDP
options.c: NBFCs’ framework which provides unsecured lending can create a great risk even to formal sector banking
options.d: Minimal costing, wider reachability, and improved risk management have given NBFCs great success

questions.stem: What is India’s mini-Lehmann moment?

options.a: The insolvency of IL&FS had squeezed the credit from other NBFCs and disrupted operation of bank also
options.b: The bankruptcy of one company that had frozen the liquidity channel of entire banking system
options.c: The bankruptcy of IL&FS that had pointed out the shortfalls of the Indian banking system
